summary: Sandbach United maintained their place at the top of the league with a commanding 3-1 victory over Cheadle Heath Nomads, with goals from Fowles, Birchall and Hatton securing an important win and extending their unbeaten run. The team now turn their attention to a big Senior Cup clash against Stockport County at home on Tuesday, followed by a tough run of league fixtures. With the squad keeping up the pressure on chasing teams, The Bach will be looking to continue their strong form in what promises to be a crucial period of the season.
